name: Possible network service scanning
description: Distinct TCP destination ports within a bounded window.
logic: Group distinct TCP conversations by source/target; count unique destination ports in a sliding window.

name: Possible internal host scanning
description: One source contacts many internal destination addresses.
logic: Count distinct RFC1918/ULA destinations in a sliding window of TCP connection attempts.

name: Possible periodic communication
description: Repeated bidirectional connections with low interval variation; not proof of C2.
logic: At least N distinct bidirectional TCP conversations to one endpoint; coefficient of interval variation at or below threshold.

name: DNS behavior indicator
description: High frequency, long high-entropy labels or excessive negative answers; not proof of tunneling.
logic: Sliding per-host DNS window; combine count with label entropy/length or NXDOMAIN ratio.

name: Potential outbound data-transfer anomaly
description: Large observed internal-to-external wire-byte transfer with directional asymmetry.
logic: Outbound wire bytes exceed minimum and sent/received ratio exceeds threshold; not proof of exfiltration.

name: Security-relevant repeated connection
description: Repeated bidirectional external connections on configured ports with observed payload.
logic: Combine configured port, external destination, repeated conversations and bidirectional payload.

name: Conflicting ARP address associations
description: One IP claimed by multiple MACs in observed ARP replies; possible conflict or spoofing indicator.
logic: Distinct sender MAC addresses in ARP replies for one sender IP.

name: HTTP metadata indicator
description: Observable HTTP metadata merits review; content is not executed.
logic: Unusual method, configured user-agent substring, long URI, command-looking parameter or large reconstructed response.

name: TLS certificate characteristic
description: Certificate validity and characteristics evaluated at the capture timestamp.
logic: Observed certificate expired/not-yet-valid at handshake, short validity, verified self-signature or detectable DNS SAN mismatch.
